'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Ivey Mike. Transcription note: 2002-style form (36+24 lines). Margins carry a joke protest ("Animated gifs are not a crime...") — not deck content

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
